dct_description_sm:
Line information containing elevation isobars to aid in the depiction of changes in elevation at 1:1,000,000 scale. (eg. mountain peaks or depressions). Contour lines captured at 1:1,000,000 scale from Digital Chart of the World data for the Yukon and surrounding area.

Distributed from [GeoYukon](https://yukon.ca/geoyukon) by the [Government of Yukon](https://yukon.ca/maps) . Discover more digital map data and interactive maps from Yukon's digital map data collection.

For more information: [geomatics.help@yukon.ca](mailto:geomatics.help@yukon.ca)
